Ranks Montgomery census tracts by the count of food establishments whose latest inspection score is below 85, using the most recent inspection per establishment from the Food Scores observations table, then joins all tracts to include those with zero failing establishments.
sql:
SELECT t.name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.entity_key) AS below_85_count, t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT geoid, entity_key, value,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY entity_key ORDER BY event_date DESC, record_id) AS rn
  FROM fw_pg.tract_observations
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261025_30eb78'
    AND source = 'm1_city'
) o ON t.geoid = o.geoid AND o.rn = 1 AND o.value IS NOT NULL AND o.value < 85
GROUP BY t.geoid, t.name
ORDER BY below_85_count DESC, t.name
LIMIT 200
